global_reason: All constructive mechanisms found reduce to Wick polynomials or products, both capped at 1/2; continuing to tune them is low value. The Q-flat question isolates exactly what any R<1/2 construction must contain and is falsifiable by search.
next_discriminating_action: (1) wait for small-N optimizer: does any finite set have R<1/2? (2) local-improvement search seeded at Bu sets (N~1500) to see if/how R drops below Bu; (3) structural attempt on Q-flat(3) via torsion-free 'order-3 pairing' impossibility.
theory_of_success: Disproof needs an FR factor with flat autocorrelation and weighted multiplicity >2 (P8), i.e. a non-Gaussian, non-product structure; proof of Chowla could come from showing such structures cannot have unbounded multiplicity (Q-flat impossibility for m large), which is a cleaner additive-combinatorics target than the full problem.
